dog.description_text:
A volunteer writes:
Toby is a handsome silver and white young cat who was part of a very busy house filled with a large number of cats and dogs. Many were brought to the care center for us to find them a home. Toby was pretty scared upon arrival, shivering and making himself as small as he could...His former owner, though, describes him as a very outgoing cat, friendly, cuddly, a lap cat who loved to rest on his owner's chest. He is said to "behave like a dog".. At the care center, though, Toby who arrived and was housed with Rory(already adopted), stays at the back of his cubby, preferring to be left alone. More recently, Toby has been coming forward with treats, allowing some petting while eating and playing very excitingly with a feather wand. Some progress! Is Toby finally starting to fall back on his four? Stay tuned! A home is what Toby very much needs, low traffic without young children and with an experienced and patient new owner determined to bring the real Toby back!. Be a hero! Ask to meet Toby at the Manhattan Care Center.
dog.name: Toby
